tools.name: nearby-mobility
tools.description:
Find the closest shared-mobility vehicles (e-scooters, city bikes, car-share, mopeds)
and rental stations near a location in Norway. Use when the user asks about renting a
scooter, bike, or car nearby ("nærmeste sparkesykkel", "find an electric scooter",
"are there city bikes near X"). Returns both free-floating vehicles and docking
stations within a search radius, sorted by distance. For public transport stops,
use `nearby-stops` instead.

location.description: Search location — address, place name, or lat,lng coordinates

formFactors.description: Filter by form factors: BICYCLE, CARGO_BICYCLE, CAR, MOPED, SCOOTER_STANDING, SCOOTER_SEATED, OTHER

propulsionTypes.description: Filter by propulsion types: HUMAN, ELECTRIC_ASSIST, ELECTRIC, COMBUSTION, COMBUSTION_DIESEL, HYBRID, PLUG_IN_HYBRID, HYDROGEN_FUEL_CELL

maxResults.description: Maximum results per category (vehicles, stations). Default 20, max 50.

language.description: Language for the UI. Detect from the conversation: 'nb' for Norwegian Bokmål, 'nn' for Norwegian Nynorsk, 'en' for English.

tools.name: alerts
tools.description:
Get active service disruptions and alerts for Norwegian public transport.
Returns situations with severity, affected lines/stops, validity period,
and descriptions in Norwegian and English.
Use when the user asks about delays, cancellations, strikes, or service disruptions.
Severity levels from lowest to highest: noImpact, verySlight, slight, normal, severe, verySevere.
Returns the most severe situations first, at most maxResults of them; situationCount
gives the total, and moreSituations is present when some were left out.

severities.description: Filter by severity. Valid values: noImpact, verySlight, slight, normal, severe, verySevere. Default: returns all severities.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of situations to return, most severe first (1-50). Default: 20.

tools.name: departures
tools.description:
Get real-time departures from a single stop or station in Norway. Use when the user
wants to see what's leaving soon from a specific location. Shows upcoming vehicles with
line numbers, destinations, platforms, occupancy, and live delay information. For planning routes
between two locations, use the trip tool instead.

stop.description: Stop place name (e.g., 'Oslo S', 'Bergen stasjon') or NSR ID (e.g., NSR:StopPlace:337)

numberOfDepartures.description: Number of departures to return (default: 5, max: 50)

startTime.description: Start time in ISO format (default: now)

timeRangeMinutes.description: Time range in minutes to search (default: 60, max: 1440)

transportModes.description: Filter by transport modes: air, bus, cableway, coach, funicular, lift, metro, monorail, rail, taxi, tram, trolleybus, unknown, water. Omit for all modes.

language.description: Language for the UI. Detect from the conversation: 'nb' for Norwegian Bokmål, 'nn' for Norwegian Nynorsk, 'en' for English.

tools.name: geocode
tools.description:
Convert place names or addresses into geographic coordinates.
Stops come back with an NSR:StopPlace ID in properties.id, which the trip and
departures tools accept as a location.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: nearby-stops
tools.description:
Find public transport stops near a location in Norway. Use this whenever
    the user asks about stops, holdeplasser, or transit options near a place,
    address, or area — not just from their current location. This is the
    canonical tool for "what's nearby" transit questions in Norway and should
    be preferred over general map/place search when the question is about
    public transport.

    Accepts addresses ("Rådhusgata 5, Oslo"), place names ("Aker brygge"),
    or coordinates. Returns stops sorted by distance with transport modes
    and live next-departures.

    Triggers (English): "stops near X", "what stops are around X", "show me
    transit near X", "what can I take from here", "nearest bus/tram/metro to X".

    Triggers (Norwegian): "vis stopp/holdeplasser i nærheten av X", "hva
    går fra X", "nærmeste buss/trikk/T-bane til X", "kollektiv i nærheten
    av X".

    Use the trip tool instead for routing between two locations, and the
    departures tool when the user already knows which stop they want.

location.description: Starting location — address, place name, or lat,lng coordinates

maxResults.description: Maximum number of stops to return (default: 10, max: 50)

transportModes.description: Filter by transport modes: air, bus, cableway, coach, funicular, lift, metro, monorail, rail, taxi, tram, trolleybus, unknown, water. Omit for all modes.

language.description: Language for the UI. Detect from the conversation: 'nb' for Norwegian Bokmål, 'nn' for Norwegian Nynorsk, 'en' for English.

tools.name: poll-departures
tools.description: Refreshes departure data for a stop. Called by the departures UI.

tools.name: poll-trip
tools.description: Re-plans a trip with updated parameters. Called by the trip map UI.

tools.name: trip
tools.description:
Plan multi-leg public transport routes between two locations across Norway and the Nordic region.
Use when the user needs journey options with departure/arrival times, transfers, occupancy, and trip duration.
For real-time departures from a specific stop, use the departures tool instead.

from.description: Starting location: address, place name, coordinates (lat,lng), or a stop ID (NSR:StopPlace:<digits>). A name uses the geocoder's first match; when it is ambiguous, such as a town with several ferry terminals, call geocode and pass the right stop's ID.

to.description: Destination location: address, place name, coordinates (lat,lng), or a stop ID (NSR:StopPlace:<digits>). A name uses the geocoder's first match; when it is ambiguous, such as a town with several ferry terminals, call geocode and pass the right stop's ID.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of trip options to return

language.description: Language for the UI. Detect from the conversation: 'nb' for Norwegian Bokmål, 'nn' for Norwegian Nynorsk, 'en' for English.

transportModes.description: Filter by transport modes: air, bus, cableway, coach, funicular, lift, metro, monorail, rail, taxi, tram, trolleybus, unknown, water. Omit for all modes.
